protocol.capacity_comparison: preupdate node count for every scored sample plus every postupdate count; first_mismatch_step is one-based within the phase
protocol.engine_deviation: EdgeClearGNG overrides assert_invariants only, omitting the isolated-node clause; the canonical engine refuses the cleared state, which is probed and recorded per seed
protocol.failure_policy: retain every seed; an arm the engine refuses to continue keeps its completed windows and its failure record
protocol.fingerprint_normalization: data and model-state fingerprints use canonical sorted-key JSON with floats rounded to 12 decimal places; source hashes remain byte-exact; within-run state checks use exact unrounded equality
protocol.measurement: squared quantization error and topographic missing-edge indicator before every update
protocol.paired_design: one warm-A model per seed is cloned twice at the end of the B intervention; only the Hebbian edge set differs at the return boundary
protocol.paired_invariance: prototype positions, node errors, node count, next node id, sample count, and parameters are compared for exact equality; both arms consume the same return signals in the same order
protocol.predecessor_cross_check: the retained arm reproduces the completed predecessor's prior-A arm for the same seed ids, data, and hyperparameters
protocol.primary_estimand: seed-mean return topographic error of the cleared arm minus the retained arm; negative favours clearing
protocol.recovery: two consecutive non-overlapping windows; onset is retrospective first-window start; confirmation is second-window end
protocol.thresholds: independent warm-A heldout QE times 1.25 and min(1, warm-A heldout TE + 0.02), frozen before the return phase and shared by both arms
protocol.treatment: clear every edge immediately before return-A learning; nothing else is modified

claim_limits: Topographic error on synthetic geometry is measured; semantic identity, label handling, drift detection, and explicit memory are not evaluated.
Five paired seeds describe this fixed panel only; there is no aggregate pass/fail and no population claim.
The treatment is a complete Hebbian edge reset, not a selective B-region reset, so it also discards valid A-region adjacency.
Cleared edges leave prototypes isolated, which the unchanged engine rejects; the treatment arm therefore relaxes only the isolated-node assertion, and that deviation is recorded per seed.
Common node caps and matched traces are not evidence of matched resources; every capacity and removal count is retained.
A reduced topographic error does not establish concept identity or a usable memory mechanism.

primary.interpretation: descriptive percentile interval over this fixed five-seed synthetic panel
primary.resampling_unit: paired seed-level mean return topographic error difference
